The '''''Instigator''''' was a [[RX4 Patrol Ship]] that served in the [[New Republic Defense Fleet/Legends|New Republic fleet]].<ref name="CSWE" />

The ship was used by a group of [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] agents who were assigned to recover a relic from a [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] named [[Mahk'khar]] located on [[Tuulab]]. The ship returned to the [[Nova (New Republic)|''Nova'']] and was then used by the team to transport them to [[Delari Prime]] for a mission to meet with [[Oron]] to get more details about the relic. While leaving the planet, the ship was ambushed by a group of four [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE interceptors]] but managed to escape them. After returning to the fleet, the team took the ''Instigator'' to [[Jaresh/Legends|Jaresh]]. The group then traveled to [[Galaan/Legends|Galaan]] where they used the ''Instigator'' to [[Assault on Galaan|defend]] a New Republic base.<ref name="R" />

The ship was disguised under the name ''Surge'' and used by a group of New Republic agents to investigate problems in the [[Betha system/Legends|Betha system]].<ref name="Counterstrike">{{JournalCite|8|Counterstrike (Adventure Journal)}}</ref>
